# NEW 2026-11-21 v9.9 Worker 2: 4 Colonial Charter Goals & Frontier Pacing 2.0 (oe_col2_). Generated by gen_v99_colonization.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 1. Imperial Maritime Factoria & Overseas Exarchate Charter
# Links cleanly to v9.0 Far Seas Plan A (oe_far_exarchate_trade / oe_far_exarchate) when active,
# while remaining fully playable for all Eurasian & Mediterranean maritime powers.
oe_goal_imperial_maritime_factoria = {
	is_available = {
		scope:owner = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			has_ports = yes
		}
		scope:target = {
			not = {
				any_location_in_province_definition = {
					controller ?= {
						not = { this = scope:owner }
					}
				}
			}
			any_location_in_province_definition = {
				is_coastal = yes
			}
		}
	}

	default_priority = {
		value = 15
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:owner = { oe_far_roman_host = yes }
				scope:target = {
					any_location_in_province_definition = {
						is_coastal = yes
						would_be_overseas_for = scope:owner
					}
				}
			}
			add = 110
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:owner = { oe_col2_is_maritime_charter_power = yes }
				scope:target = {
					any_location_in_province_definition = {
						is_coastal = yes
						would_be_overseas_for = scope:owner
					}
				}
			}
			add = 65
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:target = {
					any_location_in_province_definition = {
						is_city = yes
						count = 0
					}
				}
			}
			scope:target = {
				ordered_location_in_province_definition = {
					limit = { is_coastal = yes }
					max = 1
					order_by = best_capital_for_colony
					save_scope_as = new_town
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:new_town } }
			scope:target = {
				ordered_location_in_province_definition = {
					max = 1
					order_by = best_capital_for_colony
					save_scope_as = new_town
				}
			}
		}
		scope:target = {
			every_location_in_province_definition = {
				change_location_owner = scope:owner
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:new_town }
			scope:new_town = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_city = no
						NOT = { location_rank = location_rank:town }
					}
					change_location_rank = location_rank:town
					cc_setup_new_town = yes
				}
			}
			oe_col2_link_far_seas_factoria = yes
			scope:owner = {
				set_variable = { name = oe_col2_last_colony_loc value = scope:new_town }
				set_variable = { name = oe_col2_last_charter_type value = 1 }
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_select = {
		value = 100
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:owner = { oe_far_roman_host = yes }
				scope:target = {
					any_location_in_province_definition = {
						is_coastal = yes
						OR = {
							oe_col2_in_eastern_factoria_corridor = yes
							oe_col2_in_atlantic_factoria_corridor = yes
						}
					}
				}
			}
			add = 2200
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:owner = { oe_col2_is_maritime_charter_power = yes }
				scope:target = {
					any_location_in_province_definition = {
						is_coastal = yes
						oe_col2_in_eastern_factoria_corridor = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = 1500
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:target = {
					NOT = { any_location_in_province_definition = { would_be_overseas_for = scope:owner } }
				}
			}
			add = -400
		}
	}
}

# 2. Steppe & Siberian Cossack Ostrog Settlement
# Dedicated East Slavic / Steppe river-fortress & Cossack host colonization model.
oe_goal_steppe_cossack_ostrog = {
	is_available = {
		scope:owner = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			oe_col2_is_cossack_frontier_power = yes
		}
		scope:target = {
			not = {
				any_location_in_province_definition = {
					controller ?= {
						not = { this = scope:owner }
					}
				}
			}
			any_location_in_province_definition = {
				oe_col2_in_steppe_siberia_zone = yes
			}
		}
	}

	default_priority = {
		value = 40
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:owner = {
					culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:russian_group }
				}
				scope:target = {
					any_location_in_province_definition = {
						oe_col2_in_steppe_siberia_zone = yes
					}
				}
			}
			add = 180
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:target = {
			ordered_location_in_province_definition = {
				max = 1
				order_by = best_capital_for_colony
				save_scope_as = new_town
			}
			every_location_in_province_definition = {
				change_location_owner = scope:owner
			}
		}
		oe_col2_settle_cossack_ostrog = yes
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:new_town }
			scope:owner = {
				set_variable = { name = oe_col2_last_colony_loc value = scope:new_town }
				set_variable = { name = oe_col2_last_charter_type value = 2 }
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_select = {
		value = 400
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:owner = {
					culture = { has_culture_group = culture_group:russian_group }
				}
			}
			add = 2500
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:owner = { oe_col2_is_cossack_frontier_power = yes }
			}
			add = 1200
		}
	}
}

# 3. Imperial Frontier Soldier-Farmer Colony (Limes / Tuntian)
# Contiguous overland frontier military-agricultural settlement with realistic early-tax tradeoff.
oe_goal_limes_soldier_farmer_colony = {
	is_available = {
		scope:owner = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			country_type = location
		}
		scope:target = {
			not = {
				any_location_in_province_definition = {
					controller ?= {
						not = { this = scope:owner }
					}
				}
			}
			any_location_in_province_definition = {
				any_neighbor_location = {
					has_owner = yes
					OR = {
						owner = scope:owner
						owner = { is_subject_of = scope:owner }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	default_priority = {
		value = 30
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:owner = { oe_col2_is_limes_empire = yes }
				scope:target = {
					NOT = { any_location_in_province_definition = { would_be_overseas_for = scope:owner } }
				}
			}
			add = 135
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:target = {
			ordered_location_in_province_definition = {
				max = 1
				order_by = best_capital_for_colony
				save_scope_as = new_town
			}
			every_location_in_province_definition = {
				change_location_owner = scope:owner
			}
		}
		oe_col2_settle_limes_colony = yes
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:new_town }
			scope:owner = {
				set_variable = { name = oe_col2_last_colony_loc value = scope:new_town }
				set_variable = { name = oe_col2_last_charter_type value = 3 }
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_select = {
		value = 250
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:owner = { oe_col2_is_limes_empire = yes }
				scope:target = {
					NOT = { any_location_in_province_definition = { would_be_overseas_for = scope:owner } }
				}
			}
			add = 1850
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:target = {
					any_location_in_province_definition = { would_be_overseas_for = scope:owner }
				}
			}
			add = -1200
		}
	}
}

# 4. Ecumenical Peaceful Mission & Coexistence Charter
# Non-violent conversion & native coexistence path trading slower colonial pace for stability and preservation.
oe_goal_ecumenical_missionary_charter = {
	is_available = {
		scope:owner = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			oe_col2_is_missionary_faith = yes
			OR = {
				stability >= 0
				estate_satisfaction:clergy_estate >= 0.5
			}
		}
		scope:target = {
			not = {
				any_location_in_province_definition = {
					controller ?= {
						not = { this = scope:owner }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	default_priority = {
		value = 25
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:owner = {
					OR = {
						tag = PAP
						government_type = government_type:theocracy
					}
				}
			}
			add = 120
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:target = {
			ordered_location_in_province_definition = {
				max = 1
				order_by = best_capital_for_colony
				save_scope_as = new_town
			}
			every_location_in_province_definition = {
				change_location_owner = scope:owner
			}
		}
		oe_col2_settle_ecumenical_mission = yes
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:new_town }
			scope:owner = {
				set_variable = { name = oe_col2_last_colony_loc value = scope:new_town }
				set_variable = { name = oe_col2_last_charter_type value = 4 }
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_select = {
		value = 200
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:owner = {
					OR = {
						tag = PAP
						government_type = government_type:theocracy
					}
				}
			}
			add = 1500
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:owner = { estate_satisfaction:clergy_estate >= 0.65 }
			}
			add = 450
		}
	}
}
